notes.title: Mountains Prestige Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the Clouds. Their Animation wasn't looping properly.
[*]Fixed the Mountains Idle Game Shop Button. It did not properly change Color when you had enough money to buy it.
[/list]

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: CoinBlock Clicker Idle Update
notes.content:
The Update includes the following:

[h3]Idle Buffs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buffed all Tubes so they all transport more Coins each Cycle which increases the base Idle Value by a Bit.
[*] The first IdleGame has an increased Idle-Coin Value from 2 to 3 And its Price is reduced from 75k to 30k with its Price Multiplier reduced from 3 to 2.
[*] Added the Possibility to upgrade each IdleGame. Clicking on one in the Idle UI opens a small Upgrade-Window. Upgrading IdleGames always costs more than purchasing that IdleGame in the Shop!
[/list]
[h3]New Stuff[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new Autoclicker Special Upgrade.
[/list]
[h3]General Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Quest "Collect Items" has been buffed. You no longer need to collect as many as before to get the Reward.
[*] The Quest "Catch Wingcoins" has been buffed. You no longer need to collect as many as before to get the Reward.
[*] Decreased the Clicks needed to gain one Ticket from 4750 to 4000. This will increase the Tickets-Spawnrate.
[*] Removed the possibility to Trash IdleGames as the IdleGame Upgrade UI takes that Place.
[/list]
[h3]Music[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the new Tundra Music Track to the Tundra Prestige-World.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Wingcoin spawning was doubled whenever a prestige was done.
[/list]

Take note that the IdleGame Price changes only become visible when you Prestige your Game or play in a new Savefile since the Prices are saved to your Savefile!

We hope you enjoy this first CoinBlock Update!
